node: Data-center power, cooling, grid interconnection, and site delivery
summary: Expanded universe for the AI data-center physical-infrastructure node. The highest-directness candidates are suppliers and contractors tied to power delivery, thermal management, liquid cooling, electrical/mechanical construction, and grid/data-center delivery. This is research coverage only, not a trading recommendation. Main chokepoint logic: even if AI chips are available, data-center deployment can be constrained by power equipment, cooling systems, interconnection, construction labor, and long-lead electrical infrastructure.
